response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), phase_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) AS station_count FROM matched GROUP BY lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS mean_avg FROM phase_stats), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_band, p.station_count, o.mean_avg FROM phase_stats p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_band > o.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_kept_avgs, SUM(station_count) AS total_kept_station_count, AVG(avg_band - mean_avg) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes are matched to observatories with an inner join, so unmatched telescopes are dropped. A NULL lunarstage forms its own group, since GROUP BY treats NULLs as one group.
The distinct station count per phase includes every matched telescope, even one whose bandusagepct is NULL. Only the bandwidth average skips missing values.
The mean of the phase averages ignores any phase whose average is NULL (all of its bandwidth values missing), and such a phase is never kept.
'Average amount by which the kept phases exceed that mean' is the mean over kept phases of (phase average minus the overall mean of phase averages), with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct stations only over telescopes that have a non-missing bandwidth usage value, so the station count and the bandwidth average use the same set of telescopes.
alternatives.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), phase_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bandusagepct IS NOT NULL THEN observstation END) AS station_count FROM matched GROUP BY lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS mean_avg FROM phase_stats), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_band, p.station_count, o.mean_avg FROM phase_stats p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_band > o.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_kept_avgs, SUM(station_count) AS total_kept_station_count, AVG(avg_band - mean_avg) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM kept;
